2607.17747.title: Mobile Network Control with a World Model
2607.17747.paper_summary: The increasing complexity of mobile networks necessitates intelligent and dynamic control strategies for efficient, energy-conserving management. We propose a world model-based approach for network control that enables adaptive configuration of crucial parameters. The world model is trained from historical data and predicts the impact of its actions on future network states. Our controller leverages the model's uncertainty estimate to robustly find optimal network configuration changes. Furthermore, the optimization objective can be changed dynamically without model retraining. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in simulated closed-loop control of a mobile network energy-saving feature. Our results show improved performance in balancing energy savings with quality of service, compared to traditional methods and reinforcement learning approaches. Finally, we show the world model performance on real network data from, and evaluate counterfactual actions proposed by the controller under various throughput constraints.
2607.17747.paper_summary_zh: 移動網絡日益增長的複雜性需要智能和動態的控制策略，以實現高效和節能的管理。<lb/>我們提出了一種基於世界模型的網絡控制方法，能夠自適應地配置關鍵參數。<lb/>該世界模型是從歷史數據中訓練而來，並預測其行動對未來網絡狀態的影響。<lb/>我們的控制器利用模型的不確定性估計，穩健地找到最佳的網絡配置變更。<lb/>此外，優化目標可以在不重新訓練模型的情況下動態改變。<lb/>我們在模擬的閉環控制中展示了該方法在移動網絡節能功能上的有效性。<lb/>與傳統方法和強化學習方法相比，我們的結果顯示在平衡節能與服務質量方面有了改善的表現。<lb/>最後，我們展示了世界模型在真實網絡數據上的表現，並評估了控制器在各種吞吐量限制下提出的反事實行動。
